LTSR.description: Limiting Slenderness Ratio (LTSR). Per-element steel/SRC design limiting slenderness ratio; the id key is the element number and all fields are optional overrides of the stored values.

bNOTCHECK.description: If true, do not check the slenderness ratio for this element.

COMP.description: Limiting slenderness ratio for compression members.

TENS.description: Limiting slenderness ratio for tension members.
